vsm1.1:107.7: 30. "'Making the whole rock resound': 'making the whole rock reverberate as one doing so by means of an earth tremor. But some say that is was owing to the cheering of the deities who lived there'" (Vism-mhṭ 58).
vsm1.1:112.5: 31. "Four-sweets"—catumadhura: a medicinal sweet made of four ingredients: honey, palm-sugar, ghee and sesame oil.
